page_title: JUV 0-0 GEN | Juventus v Genoa 17/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+3' Yet another yellow card and Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is sent off for talking out of turn to the referee. Definitely a harebrained moment from the player. Antonio Giua doesn't allow any discussions.
90+2' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
90+2' Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) works the corner short.
90+1' Timothy Weah (Juventus) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Corner kick. Juventus will have an opportunity.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Moise Kean (Juventus) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the left post! A few inches to the right and it could have been a sweet goal!
88' Good movement by Timothy Weah (Juventus), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
86' Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) takes the corner but it's cleared.

86' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Juventus.
85' Alberto Gilardino has decided to make a change. Emil Bohinen (Genoa) replaces Milan Badelj.
85' Alberto Gilardino prepares a substitution. Mattia Bani is replaced by Giorgio Cittadini (Genoa).
84' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
82' A substitution has been made. Andrea Cambiaso goes off and Moise Kean (Juventus) comes on.
80' Federico Gatti (Juventus) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Josep Martinez, who smothers the ball.
79' Alberto Gilardino decides to make a substitution. Mateo Retegui will be replaced by David Ankeye (Genoa).
78' Substitution. Timothy Weah (Juventus) replaces Fabio Miretti.
75' What a chance that is! Andrea Cambiaso swings the ball into the box, and Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) gets in front of his man and powers his header just over the bar.
72' 62:38 – the ratio of ball possession.
70' Alberto Gilardino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) replacing Albert Gudmundsson.
69' Substitution. Kevin Strootman (Genoa) in, Morten Frendrup out.
69' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the left-hand post.
67' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) sends the corner into the box, but Josep Martinez intercepts it and averts the threat.
67' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
67' POST! Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the right post. What a strike that was!
65' The referee is firm and issues Vitinha (Genoa) a deserved yellow card.
63' Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
62' A cross into the box from Federico Gatti (Juventus) is cleared. The ball is out of play. Juventus win a corner kick.
59' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to substitute Filip Kostic and he is replaced by Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus).
59' Here is a change. Federico Chiesa is going off and Massimiliano Allegri gives the last tactical orders to Kenan Yildiz (Juventus).
58' Substitution. Weston McKennie is replaced by Adrien Rabiot (Juventus).
58' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
57' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
55' A quickly taken corner by Juventus.

54' Filip Kostic (Juventus) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Juventus force their opponents to concede a corner.
47' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
46' Federico Gatti (Juventus) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. Now Juventus have a corner.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) tries to find Dusan Vlahovic, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
40' Junior Messias (Genoa) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
39' Danilo (Juventus) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
38' Filip Kostic (Juventus) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
33' Filip Kostic (Juventus) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

32' Federico Gatti (Juventus) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. Juventus force a corner. They send men into the box.
27' Federico Gatti (Juventus) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Josep Martinez, who makes a comfortable save.
26' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
26' Djed Spence (Genoa) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee signals a corner kick to Genoa.
24' A precise low pass is received by Mateo Retegui (Genoa), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
22' Filip Kostic (Juventus) whips in a cross from the corner, but Josep Martinez is well positioned and punches the ball away.
21' One of the Juventus players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
16' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Fabio Miretti (Juventus) takes it short.

16' Filip Kostic (Juventus) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The linesman makes the right call and Juventus will have a corner.
12' Great teamplay by Juventus as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
8' The corner from Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) is intercepted by the defence.

7' Mattia Bani (Genoa) leaps highest around the penalty spot to meet a cross from the free kick and produces a promising goal-bound header towards the roof of the net, but Wojciech Szczesny pulls off a fine save to deny him. The ball is out of play. Genoa will have a chance to score from a corner.
6' Antonio Giua blows the whistle, Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) is penalised for a foul. That's a free kick to Genoa.
4' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

4' Weston McKennie (Juventus) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Juventus.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Genoa will have the kick-off.
Antonio Giua is the one to supervise the game today.
